title: Coherent higher direct images over a valuation ring
statement: Let A be a valuation ring, let f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A) be proper, flat, and of finite presentation [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let F be a \mathcal O_X-module that is locally free of constant finite rank [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Then for every q\geq0, H^q(X,F) is a finitely presented A-module.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma lemma-triviality-generic-fibre-valuation-ring, Tag 0EX8, proof using coherence of valuation rings and coherent cohomology

proof.text: Choose a finite affine trivializing cover of X (finite because f is of finite presentation). On each trivializing affine, F is a finite free module, so the local presentations glue to show that F is finitely presented. Since f is flat, O_X is flat over A; each such finite free F is therefore A-flat, and flatness is local on X, so F is flat over Spec(A). Apply [lem-pc-rf-perfect-base-change] to f and F. Its hypotheses are exactly properness and finite presentation of f, finite presentation of F, and flatness over the base, so E := Rf_*F is a perfect object of D(O_{Spec(A)}).

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.30.4, Tag 0B91, clause (2)

proof.text: A is coherent: by definition of a valuation ring every nonzero finitely generated ideal I of A is principal, I=aA with a\neq0, and since A is a domain multiplication by a gives A\cong aA, so I is free of rank one and hence finitely presented (Stacks, Algebra, Example 0EWV). Next, E=Rf_*F is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], so Spec(A) has an open covering (U_i) with E|_{U_i} strictly perfect. Since A is local, the only open subset of Spec(A) containing the closed point is Spec(A) itself, so some U_i equals Spec(A); thus E is strictly perfect on the affine Spec(A), and by the affine description in [def-pc-perfect-complex] (Tag 08EB) E\cong\widetilde{P^\bullet} for a bounded complex P^\bullet of finite projective A-modules. As M\mapsto\widetilde M is exact, R^qf_*F=H^q(E)\cong\widetilde{H^q(P^\bullet)} [def-pc-derived-direct-image], a quasi-coherent sheaf on Spec(A). By [lem-sc-coherent-ring-perfect-complex-cohomology], applied to the coherent ring A, each H^q(P^\bullet) is finitely presented over A. Finally F is quasi-coherent [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module], so the Leray spectral sequence [pqf-lem-leray] E_2^{p,q}=H^p(\operatorname{Spec}(A),R^qf_*F)\Rightarrow H^{p+q}(X,F) applies; its terms with p>0 vanish by [lem-pc-affine-vanishing] since R^qf_*F is quasi-coherent on the affine scheme Spec(A). Hence it degenerates and H^q(X,F)\cong\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}(A),R^qf_*F)=H^q(P^\bullet), which is finitely presented over A for every q\geq0.
